headline: Discussion of Summer Racial Justice Academy reflections, equity report follow-up, and meeting topics for upcoming months.
summary: The committee will discuss outcomes from the Summer Racial Justice Academy, including workforce diversity, curriculum, and disciplinary actions for students with IEPs. Members will also set future meeting topics and review follow-up items from the equity report and June meeting.
items: Reflection on Summer Racial Justice Academy, including diverse work force, diverse curriculum, and disciplinary actions for students with IEPs
Set meeting topics for next few months, including equity collaborative, new Learning Framework, personnel recruitment policy, inclusive curriculum policy, and Behavioral Threat Assessment policy
Review equity report Section 1 on Leadership and Planning, including update on anti-bias training policy statement
Follow-up from June meeting on the role of principals in anti-bias culture and whether it is included in evaluations
location: Sustainability Academy - Community Room, 123 North Street
